title: The Lovász Local Lemma Threshold T(d) Strictly Beats the Classical e-Bound
description: Quantifies the gap between the sharp algebraic LLL threshold T(d) = dᵈ/(d+1)ᵈ⁺¹ and the classical bound 1/(e(d+1)), proving T(d) > 1/(e(d+1)) for every d ≥ 1 — equivalently e(d+1)·T(d) > 1 — so the sharp threshold admits strictly more probability mass. The single analytic ingredient is (1 + 1/d)ᵈ < e (one_add_inv_pow_lt_exp_one), derived from Mathlib’s Real.add_one_lt_exp and Real.exp_nat_mul; stated over ℝ via the real cast of the parent’s rational threshold. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
